mainEntity.name: Can AI handle customer emails and support for my small online business?

acceptedAnswer.text:
AI can support customer service with drafted replies, FAQ organization, first-line responses, and routing, but it should not automatically improvise on sensitive or unusual issues. Run My AI Biz includes first-line support and administrative workflow examples with human review.

Customers need accurate answers, appropriate tone, and a clear escalation path. A fast incorrect reply can create more work than a slower reviewed draft.

Key factors:
- Which questions have stable, approved answers.
- What information the system may access.
- When a human must take over.
- How responses are logged and corrected.

Create an approved answer base, test common and unusual questions, and require review for refunds, complaints, account changes, or uncertain requests. Audit a sample of responses regularly and update the instructions when errors appear.

Run My AI Biz can help structure support preparation while preserving human oversight for exceptions.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI can draft replies, organize FAQs, and handle routine first-line questions, but uncertain, sensitive, or consequential requests should go to a human. Use approved answers, escalation rules, review, and regular audits.
